$comment: ADR-501: dedicated animal-track art. The atlas has NO image file of its own: its pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/footprints-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the task34 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas (items_build, the 64px creature atlas, like the bee) only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is one row of 8 frames (one per facing, dirStride 1): frame f is the track (two small iso-aligned ovals) pointing along the facing-f ground direction (TASK34_DIR_VEC). The sprite anchor is the track centre, so the VFX overlay can stamp it exactly where the paw landed.
name: survivaz-task501
